title: Three core products of MiniMax officially incorporated into Singapore's national AI training program

content_html:
The Singapore Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) has recently officially launched a series of artificial intelligence-related courses aimed at enhancing comprehensive digital and intelligent labor skills. As an important partner of this initiative, three core products of Chinese artificial intelligence company MiniMax - MiniMax Agent, HaiLuo AI, and MiniMax Audio - have been successfully included in this official training program through Singtel AI Pass.

According to the policy announced this time, the Singapore Skills and Workforce Development Agency will provide eligible participants with a free six-month subscription to advanced AI tools. This move not only provides local professionals and developers with an opportunity to directly access and use cutting-edge generative AI products, but also marks the accelerating integration of Chinese AI companies' technology and product services into the global mainstream public education and skills ecosystem.
